issue.title: test_proc_producer_inventory fails: New Project apply split moved _submit_project_add/_create out of new_project_apply.py

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Reproduces deterministically on a clean master checkout: tests/ace/tui/test_proc_producer_inventory.py::test_inventory_matches_live_production_source failed in sase tool run check 340199e56682f532ca76bf69e2775b08 (full lane, master 3c08c4676f) and again standalone (`.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_proc_producer_inventory.py`, 1 failed / 3 passed). It is a static source-vs-inventory comparison, so it cannot pass intermittently. Root cause: 35e9768444 (refactor(ace): split new project apply flow, toobig-7v.new_project_apply.0) moved `_submit_project_add` and `_submit_project_create` from src/sase/ace/tui/modals/new_project_apply.py into src/sase/ace/tui/modals/_new_project_apply_flow.py (lines 126 and 152), but the proc-producer inventory in src/sase/ace/tui/_proc_producer_sites_actions.py (about lines 463 and 495) still names new_project_apply.py, so the test reports both 'direct_submit_durable' sites (project.add, project.create) as stale. Fix: re-point those two inventory entries at _new_project_apply_flow.py (and check the facade split left no other moved producer sites). Not caused by the Agents Archive epic, whose landing does not touch either file.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the sase-1jm.9 land agent's check run; the New Project apply split left two stale proc-producer inventory entries, a deterministic master-red failure no task tracks.
